item.list.tasmanian_giant_freshwater_cra: §7§oThe Tasmanian giant freshwater lobster is the largest freshwater lobster in the world.
§7§oValued for its enormous size and delicious meat, it is considered a luxury delicacy.
§7§oHowever, it is an endangered species, strictly protected, and its harvesting is restricted.
§7§oIt is also known as the 'living fossil of freshwater.'
